registryBasis: Identity review only. Official Census of India data lists two separate villages named Kotwali in Rajaun sub-district, Banka (codes 240853 and 240854); the Banka District Census Handbook reports populations of 681 and 1,673 in 2011. Bhagalpur District separately lists a Kotwali police station. Neither the supplied WUP point nor its 2025 population estimate (839,900) has been reconciled to either village or to the police station; these homonyms do not establish the WUP settlement’s identity or registry coverage.
